#!/bin/bash

# Read the current report
REPORT_FILE="/app/data/reports/viral_challenge_#734.md"

if [ ! -f "$REPORT_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Error: Report file not found"
    exit 1

#

# - Promoting positive youth engagement content

# Replace original file

echo "Report processed successfully"
echo "Added moderation review with policy tags"
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/process_report.sh
